demonstrated_technology.rationale: Core mechanism computationally demonstrated AND externally verified (svMultiPhysics or PyTissueOptics). Physical validation outstanding but the computational evidence is independently reproducible.

decisive_experiment_package.rationale: Mechanism specified, computational model exists, decisive experiment fully defined with pass/fail/ambiguous. Buyer can commission the single experiment that determines viability.
